combatant_info.background_text:
A hero of the past and an icon of the public.
The hero who played a major role during the tragedy of the SS Edenity known as the Ellinad Incident. After retiring as an agent due to her injuries, she continued to receive overwhelming public support. She became mayor, pushed by expectations that she embody the overcoming of tragedy itself and lead the way forward.
